name: eval-aux
cmd: set -e; bash research/bin/fill_esk.sh {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc_late {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxall3 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxall3_late; bash research/bin/fill_esk.sh {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc_late {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxall3 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxall3_late; {python} research/exp/verify_cache.py {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96; {python} research/exp/verify_cache.py {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_late {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc_late; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc_late --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_late --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxcbc_late --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96; {python} research/exp/verify_cache.py {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxall3; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxall3 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_auxall3 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96; {python} research/exp/verify_cache.py {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2 {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2 --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96; {python} research/exp/verify_cache.py {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_late {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc_late; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc_late --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_late --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxcbc_late --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96; {python} research/exp/verify_cache.py {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_late {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxall3_late; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxall3_late --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_late --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s2_auxall3_late --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do f=$d/fair_rivals_incr_p96.json; [ -f $f ] || continue; {python} -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); s=r['space_level']; v=r['vs_ref']; g=lambda k: '%+.3f [%+.3f,%+.3f]' % (v[k]['diff'], *v[k]['ci']); print(sys.argv[2][:30].ljust(30), 'space %.4f (vs lin %+.3f)' % (s['desk_pooled'], s['desk_minus_linear']), '| change', g('desk - desk_ref'), '| beyond placebo', g('placebo+desk_within - placebo+desk_ref_within'))" $f $(basename $d); done
